data.title: StaticGen
data.description: Static site generator in Go that turns Markdown into a complete website with tags, categories, RSS, and search

introduction: Building a blog or documentation site shouldn't require a heavy framework. StaticGen takes a directory of Markdown files and produces a full website — HTML pages, tag and category listings, an archive, an RSS feed, a sitemap, and a client-side search index — all from a single binary with a dev server that live-reloads on changes.

capabilities: Markdown rendering with GFM extensions, typographer, and syntax highlighting via Chroma
Tag and category taxonomy pages with per-section listings and a chronological archive
RSS 2.0 feed, XML sitemap, and JSON search index generation
Dev server with file watching and live reload over Server-Sent Events
Link checker that reports broken internal links, dead images, and dangling anchors
Pretty URLs, minification, draft/future post control, and alias redirects
architecture: Go application structured with Cobra CLI commands feeding into a pipeline of build stages. Content loading parses Markdown with goldmark and YAML frontmatter, the site model assembles sections and taxonomies, the render engine processes html/templates with a built-in default theme, and publish writes the final output. The dev server uses SSE for real-time browser reloading on file changes.

data.title: GDSF
data.description: CLI tool for downloading specific folders from GitHub repositories without cloning the entire project

introduction: Most Git workflows require cloning entire repositories when you only need a single directory. GDSF solves this with an interactive TUI that lets you browse, multi-select, and download specific folders from any public GitHub repo — no full clone required.

capabilities: Interactive TUI for browsing GitHub repositories with live directory tree navigation
Multi-folder selection across any directory level with side-panel preview
CLI mode for quick one-off downloads via direct GitHub URL
Per-file byte-level progress bar during downloads
GitHub token support to avoid API rate limits (60 → 5000 req/hr)
Recursive downloads that automatically fetch all subdirectories
architecture: Built on Bubbletea TUI framework with a component-based architecture separating browse, confirm, and progress views. The GitHub API client handles authentication and pagination, while the downloader recursively fetches files with streaming progress tracking. CLI argument parsing allows both interactive and direct-download modes.

data.title: MlisStroke
data.description: Keystroke visualizer desktop app with real-time key event capture and display

introduction: Typing testers and streamers need a way to show their keystrokes live. MlisStroke captures keyboard events at the OS level using Rust and renders them in a React frontend via Tauri, creating a lightweight cross-platform desktop app.

capabilities: OS-level keyboard event capture using Rust backend for low-latency input detection
Real-time keystroke rendering in React frontend with customizable display options
Tauri integration for native desktop performance with web-based UI flexibility
Cross-platform support targeting Windows with potential macOS/Linux expansion
architecture: Tauri architecture splits concerns between a Rust backend for system-level keyboard hook registration via Windows API and a React frontend for rendering. Events flow from the OS hook through Tauri's IPC bridge to the React state, which debounces and displays keys with configurable styling and timeout.

data.title: Lancey
data.description: Simple load balancer in Go with health checks, rate limiting, and metrics

introduction: Production load balancers like Nginx or HAProxy are powerful but complex to configure for simple use cases. Lancey strips load balancing down to essentials — round-robin or least-connections routing, health checks, rate limiting, and basic metrics — in a single Go binary.

capabilities: Round-robin and least-connections load balancing algorithms
Configurable health checks with automatic backend removal on failure
Per-IP rate limiting with sliding window counter
Request metrics collection for latency and throughput monitoring
Hot-reload of backend server configuration without downtime
architecture: Single-binary Go application using the standard library's http.ReverseProxy as the core forwarding mechanism. Health checks run in a background goroutine, updating a concurrent-safe backend pool. Rate limiting uses a token bucket per client IP. Metrics are exposed via a /metrics endpoint for Prometheus scraping.

data.title: Rental
data.description: Room booking management API with authentication, authorization, and conflict detection

introduction: Room booking systems often suffer from double-booking issues and unclear permission boundaries. Rental provides a complete RESTful API with Sanctum authentication, policy-based authorization, and automatic date conflict detection to prevent overlapping reservations.

capabilities: 14 RESTful endpoints covering authentication, rooms, and bookings
Token-based authentication with Laravel Sanctum
Policy-based authorization separating admin and user permissions
Automatic conflict detection preventing double-booked dates
Auto-calculated pricing based on stay duration
Comprehensive test suite covering all major features
architecture: Laravel 13 application following RESTful conventions with Eloquent ORM for database operations. Authentication uses Sanctum token-based flow. Authorization is handled through Policy classes that check ownership and admin status. Booking creation includes a date range overlap query before insertion, ensuring no conflicts.
